name: Hy3 Preview
short: Tencent's Apr 2026 Hy3 preview (295B/21B MoE, 256K) - SWE-bench Verified 74.4%, Terminal-Bench 2.0 54.4% - superseded by the Apache-2.0 GA Hy3.
pricingNote: OpenRouter list \.18/\.60 per 1M (cache \.06); no Tencent rate card
pricingTiers: OpenRouter $0.18/$0.60 per 1M in/out, $0.06 cached read (sole GMICloud endpoint)
Self-host $0 (Tencent Hy Community License Agreement, not Apache)
standout: The preview that made Tencent's Hy line credible - the same 295B/21B architecture the GA release shipped three months later.
tradeoff: Superseded by GA Hy3 (Apache-2.0, SWE-bench Verified 78.0%) and still bound by the more restrictive community licence.
